dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Okay! Ahem... My dearest companion, is there something you wish to tell me?

choices.text: Actually, I've been pretty tired lately...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hee-hee... My warrior, you've worked so hard.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...When you just can't find any more energy, and the world falls into a haze — even apples lose their sweet flavor.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If you can get some quality shut-eye at this time, you'll feel a lot better when you wake up.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Here, I'll lend you my shoulder.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Whenever you need me, I'll always be by your side.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Many people may feel lost at times. After all, it's impossible for everything to happen according to your own wishes.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: At a time like this, ask yourself what the most important thing is!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Even if life's all in a jumble, you can sort it out as long as there's a whisper of the wind.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your serious face... is a rare sight.
